title: Anthropic’s new Claude feature is quietly selling you on AI
slides: Can Claude sell your product without you saying a word?
Anthropic now embeds commerce links inside Claude's replies.
The AI doesn't just recommend—it completes the transaction.
Your customers skip your website entirely to buy instantly.
Test one purchase flow today before your competitors do.
thread_text:
1. Your buyer won't even visit you

Claude now embeds commerce links in replies. The transaction happens inside the chat.

2. The AI closes the deal

Anthropic lets Claude complete purchases, not just recommend. Your site becomes optional.

3. Customer skips your entire funnel

No landing page, no cart. The journey ends where the recommendation started.

4. Trust is now the product

If Claude recommends a competitor, you lose the sale without a chance to pitch back.

5. Test a one-click purchase flow today

Simulate a transaction through Claude's reply. If you haven't, start before a competitor does.
